extraction_notes: Zener semantics preserved: the nominal reverse breakdown voltage VZ = 15.0 V is paired with the tabulated reverse test current IZT = 5 mA, not with the forward-voltage rating.

The BZT52C15 row gives VZ = 14.25 V minimum, 15.00 V nominal, and 15.75 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum Zener impedance ZZT = 30 ohm at IZT; maximum knee impedance ZZK = 200 ohm at IZK = 1 mA; admissible Zener current IZM = 5 mA; and temperature-coefficient limits of 9.2 to 13.0 mV/degC at IZTC.
The BZT52C15 row gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 0.1 microA at VR = 10.5 V and Ta = 25 degC. The p. 1 maximum rating gives VF = 0.9 V maximum at IF = 10 mA and power dissipation PD = 350 mW.

The six zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZT52C15 trace labeled 15 in p. 3 Fig. 2 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no points were interpolated or synthesized. The figure states Ta = 25 degC, pulsed, and shows a PD = 500 mW envelope.

Capacitance is shown only as family-level typical curves in p. 3 Fig. 3 at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz, with 0 V, 1 V, and 50% of nominal VZ bias curves; no tabulated BZT52C15 capacitance value is provided, so capacitance is null.
No reverse-recovery-time specification or test circuit is published in the supplied datasheet, so reverse recovery is null.
The supplied datasheet covers the BZT52C2V0 through BZT52C75 family; this extraction is restricted to the BZT52C15 row.
